Title: Azure Cosmos DB Updates in Azure Preview portal

Body.Content:
A number of Azure Cosmos DB enhancements were made in the Azure Preview portal, including:

  • Query Explorer enhancements
  • Document Explorer improvements
  • A new Script Explorer

For more detailed information, see Querying and Editing Azure Cosmos DB Data Just Got Better.
